rules.rationale: Explicit student stories section and individual people pages linked from the homepage.
Explicit scholarship and financial aid opportunities section.
Program requirements and academic calendars remain academic information within current-student resources.
Practical student services, financial planning, advising and relocation guidance.
Homepage-linked graduation reception recap reports a program event.

fallback.rationale: Official dual BA program curriculum, admissions and academic community information.
